scenario: [LCAP.2.10] / [LDIA.3.3.7]: the deferred-setting refusal precedes the constraint check of [LDIA.3.5.1]. The block sets `call: false` and `storage_hydrate_facts: true`, which breaks [LCAP.3.8]'s `storage_hydrate_facts` requires `call` (and `default`'s `nocooldown` requires `call`); the compiler refuses the deferred setting with DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DEFERRED, so a compiler that checks the constraints first reports DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_CONSTRAINT instead. PATH PINNED: the [LCAP.2.10] arm of the deferred-setting check in override resolution in `dsc.dialect`, ahead of the constraint check.
rules_ds:
use default:
    call: false
    storage_hydrate_facts: true

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

rule r:
    Sensor
->
    log info "x"
